name: Return to Bellowfiz

angles.text: A stout dwarven brew like Evershine is always in high demand across Dun Morogh, making its safe delivery to thirsty comrades second nature.
Pilot Bellowfiz is a dwarven siege-engine driver stationed at Steelgrill's Depot, and keeping hardworking engineers refreshed keeps the machines running smoothly.
Running errands between dwarven hunters and dwarven pilots helps maintain morale and camaraderie among Alliance forces stationed in Dun Morogh.

faq.answer: Return to Bellowfiz is a delivery task in Dun Morogh where an adventurer brings a freshly acquired cask of Evershine directly to Pilot Bellowfiz at Steelgrill's Depot.
faq.q: What is the quest Return to Bellowfiz?

faq.answer: Pilot Bellowfiz is a dwarven driver of a siege engine, stationed at Steelgrill's Depot just outside Kharanos in Dun Morogh. He eagerly awaits a fresh delivery of Evershine to sample.
Evershine is a potent local brew crafted in Dun Morogh, secured in a sturdy cask and prized by thirsty pilots and locals alike.
faq.q: What is the cask of Evershine?

faq.answer: Pilot Bellowfiz is located at Steelgrill's Depot, an engineering hub and workshop situated just east of Kharanos in Dun Morogh.
faq.q: Where do you deliver the cask?

faq.answer: After helping out with hunting tasks in the region, an adventurer is entrusted with a cask of Evershine to deliver to Pilot Bellowfiz, who has been eagerly anticipating a taste.
faq.q: Why was the Evershine sent to Bellowfiz?

aliases: what does bellowfiz do with brew
faq.answer: Upon receiving the cask, Pilot Bellowfiz is thoroughly satisfied, declaring that it will do just fine and immediately moving to crack open a bottle for a taste.
faq.q: What happens when Bellowfiz receives the Evershine?

sections.body: Return to Bellowfiz is an errand in the snowy reaches of Dun Morogh. After aiding with local hunting, an adventurer receives a freshly brewed cask of Evershine with instructions to carry it straight to Pilot Bellowfiz at Steelgrill's Depot. It is a straightforward favor that highlights the informal camaraderie and mutual support that keep the cold frontier running.
sections.title: A Cask for the Depot

sections.body: Steelgrill's Depot serves as a busy center of mechanical testing, vehicle maintenance, and gnomish craft just outside Kharanos. For pilots stationed out in the freezing winds, nothing hits the spot quite like a draught of strong local drink. Pilot Bellowfiz wastes no time upon delivery, eager to uncork a bottle on the spot and enjoy the fruits of local labor.
sections.title: Thirsty Aviators

summary: Return to Bellowfiz is a short delivery quest in Dun Morogh where an adventurer brings a cask of local Evershine to Pilot Bellowfiz at Steelgrill's Depot. It concludes a local favor, rewarding the thirsty driver with a welcome drink.
